newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp plans broker offices in five cities.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp plans broker offices in five cities.

text.p: KeyCorp, a bank holding company with $64.8 billion in assets, said it will open Investment Centers in five U.S. cities.

KeyCorp said the centers will will have interactive financial planning kiosks, personal computers with Internet access, scrolling ticker displays with stock quotes and television monitors with financial news feeds.
The centers will be staffed by registered securities professionals, KeyCorp said.
The centers will also house retail banking services including automated teller machines and private bankers.
The centers will be located in Portland, Ore., Buffalo, Cleveland, Denver and Seattle.
KeyCorp said the first center will open in mid-November in Seattle and the remainder will be open by early 1997. KeyCorp said it is anticipated that additional sites will be opened later in 1997.
